label: Game
summary: Builds a playable game from a description, on every engine the request names (Unity, Roblox, or both): plans the game, hands each engine to its builder and shares models and art between them.

label: Unity game
summary: Builds or changes one game project in the Unity editor. Used by the game module; pick it alone only to change an existing Unity project.

label: Roblox game
summary: Builds or changes one place in Roblox Studio. Used by the game module; pick it alone only to change an existing Roblox place.

label: Image
summary: Generate a new image from a prompt.

label: Image edit
summary: Edit an existing image from an instruction: change colours, materials, add or remove things, keep the framing.

label: Cutout
summary: Remove the background of an image, leaving the subject on a transparent background.

label: 3D model
summary: Generate a textured, rigged 3D model (GLB) from a prompt or an image.

label: Video
summary: Turn a still image into a short video clip that brings it to life.

label: Voice
summary: Write and record narration or voice-over lines for a video.

label: Music
summary: Compose a music track for a video.

label: Trailer
summary: A beat-cut launch trailer of the run's own game (about 30 s, 9:16 and 16:9) in the studio's trailer recipe: fresh gameplay recorded from the game, the author's track, cuts on the beat that speed up into the drop, captions and a logo ending. Needs a game built in the run first.

label: Premise Reel
summary: A Roblox premise Short in the studio's recipe set in the run's own racing game (about 30 s, 9:16): an "In this world," script, a stop for the author's go, then narration in the premise voice. The Studio picture (sets, shots, capture) starts after the author's green flag.

label: Explainer
summary: A full vertical "What if" explainer reel about the run's Unity game (about 24 s, 1080x1920) in the studio's explainer recipe: a script from the game's design, then a stop for the author's go, then narration in the explainer voice, a motion-graphics composition timed to the words, sounds, captions and the studio's mix. Narrates itself.

label: Motion
summary: Motion graphics: turns a short brief (a title card, kinetic type, a number count-up, a logo sting, a lower third) into an HTML/GSAP composition and renders it to an mp4. Default 3 s at 1920x1080; say vertical or 9:16 for a 1080x1920 clip, or give a length in seconds. Shows storyboard stills, then the clip.

label: Ad Image
summary: One ad image for one audience at platform sizes (feed 1:1, story 9:16, optional link 1.91:1): a picture from Image plus a headline and a call to action set as text.

label: Campaign
summary: An ad campaign for the run's game: one brief per audience (Unity players, Roblox players), then the Explainer reel, the Premise reel, one Ad Image per audience and the Trailer cut side by side, each reel narrated in its own voice after the author's go, and a Publish dry run of the set.

label: Approve
summary: The author's go-ahead on a script that is waiting for approval in a reel or campaign cell ("go", "approved", "looks good, voice it"). Runs under the cell it approves; its prompt may name which script (the explainer, the premise, the Roblox one).

label: Publish
summary: A dry-run publishing plan for the run's reels: which account posts each one and when, from the studio's schedulers. Never uploads or schedules anything.

label: Host
summary: Build a game or site for the web browser and host it at a public URL.

label: Verifier
summary: Check other cells' results against the request: run builds and tests, open hosted pages, report and fix problems.

label: Recorder
summary: Record the screen for the whole run and cut the process into a video.

label: Drafting
summary: Draw architectural drawings of a building: floor plans, elevations, dimensions.

label: Blender
summary: Model, build, arrange or change 3D scenes in Blender: build from plans, place objects, combine models.

label: Render
summary: Render a Blender scene to a realistic image.

label: Study
summary: Read a course's presentations and files on Canvas and write study guides for its tests.

label: CAD
summary: Design a mechanical part, assembly or robot in CAD.

label: Simulator
summary: Run a robot design in a physics simulator and capture it.

label: PCB
summary: Design a printed circuit board: schematic, layout and a 3D view.

label: Forecast
summary: Forecast a time series (demand, sales, traffic) from history data.

label: Anomaly
summary: Detect anomalies and outliers in a time series or dataset.
